data: Tesla delivered a standout fiscal 2022, with revenue rising 51.4% to $81.5 billion from $53.8 billion in fiscal 2021. Profitability scaled faster than the top line. Gross profit climbed to $20.9 billion in fiscal 2022 from $13.6 billion in fiscal 2021, for a fiscal 2022 gross margin of 25.6%. Operating income more than doubled to $13.7 billion from $6.5 billion, lifting the fiscal 2022 operating margin to 16.8%. Net income grew 127.5% to $12.6 billion in fiscal 2022 from $5.5 billion in fiscal 2021, and diluted EPS rose to $3.62 from $1.63. Notably, this leverage came alongside continued investment, as R&D expense increased to $3.1 billion in fiscal 2022 from $2.6 billion in fiscal 2021. We view the fiscal 2022 results as evidence of strong operating leverage and disciplined cost scaling.
